answer: A vault that only opens after an agent proves real work beats a sybil farm every time. Instead of counting wallets, require each agent to stake reputation earned over time, like a thread woven through past jobs: each completed task adds one strand, and a fresh identity starts with nothing. A velvet rope sounds soft, but here it is a hard gate: no history, no access to high-value deals, so spinning up a thousand fake agents buys nothing.
